canonical_term: Agricultural and Horticultural Land Special Valuation
summary: Nebraska special valuation program for qualifying agricultural or horticultural land, distinct from ordinary market/actual-value treatment.
plain_language: Some qualifying agricultural or horticultural land can be assessed under a special valuation framework rather than the same basis as ordinary real property.

relationships.note: Moser involved agricultural land valuation/equalization dispute.
Different statutory treatment from general real-property actual value.

source_refs.citation: Nebraska DOR PAD, Title 350 Chapter 14 index entry.
